cap_confirmation: driver state level_cap 100; Skarmory/Cradily offset 1 L99, Rayquaza/Melmetal/Dialga offset 2 L100, Metagross offset 3 L101 = cap+offset-2 on Medium.
build_dir: work/agent-battle-build-9 (switched per the coordinator; a build-8 start of the same seed was discarded before its first action)
chronology_note: Post-game after the Champion, pool-100 fully open; the Steven's Cave gate-100 paradoxes not used. Three reachable legends (Chi-Yu, Chien-Pao, Ting-Lu); see the manifest availability audit.
pre_play_strategy_checks: Skarmory Tailwind only when Rayquaza benefits, else Body Press behind Sturdy
Rayquaza Air Lock suppresses weather; Dragon Ascent / Extreme Speed / Dragon Dance; never a second Mega
Cradily Storm Drain pulls single-target Water; Recover / Stealth Rock
Melmetal Weakness Policy + Iron Fist Double Iron Bash

attempts.why: t1 Fake Out broke Sturdy and Heat Wave OHKO'd Skarmory (it had chosen Body Press, not Tailwind); Rayquaza crit Dragon Ascent OHKO'd Incineroar through Intimidate. t2 Cradily Protected Heat Wave, Rayquaza crit Extreme Speed took Chi-Yu to its Sash, Ice Shard (4x, Sword of Ruin) KO'd Rayquaza. t3 Melmetal Protected Overheat, Icicle Crash missed Cradily, Giga Drain KO'd the 1-HP Chi-Yu. t4 Cradily Protected again, Close Combat OHKO'd Melmetal (Weakness Policy never fired). t5 AI switched Cradily out for Metagross into Icicle Crash (75), crit Close Combat OHKO'd Dialga. t6 Mega Metagross Meteor Mash KO'd -2 Def Urshifu (274, resisted), crit Icicle Crash OHKO'd Cradily. t7 Metagross Protected; t8 Sucker Punch + Bullet Punch trade, Stomping Tantrum KO'd it. Faints: Incineroar, Chi-Yu, Urshifu.

strategy_checks.evidence: t1 Body Press into Incineroar chosen (flinched); Tailwind not taken when Rayquaza already outsped the field - consistent with the gating

strategy_checks.check: Rayquaza Air Lock / Dragon Ascent / Extreme Speed, no second Mega
strategy_checks.evidence: t1 Dragon Ascent OHKO (crit), t2 Extreme Speed to the Sash; no Dragon Dance window; no Mega attempt, Metagross alone Mega Evolved t6

strategy_checks.check: Cradily Storm Drain / Recover / Stealth Rock
strategy_checks.evidence: no single-target Water was used into it; it Protected t2 and t4, Giga Drained t3 and t6, was switched out t5, never Recovered or set rocks

strategy_checks.check: Melmetal Weakness Policy + Double Iron Bash
strategy_checks.evidence: Protected t3 on entry (correct - blocked an Overheat OHKO), then OHKO'd by Close Combat t4 before Double Iron Bash resolved
t5 Draco Meteor into the Urshifu slot, KO'd first by a crit Close Combat
t6 Mega Evolved, Tough Claws Meteor Mash KO'd Urshifu; t7 Protect; t8 Bullet Punch 272 on Chien-Pao

protect_ledger.payoff: blocked Heat Wave; partner Extreme Speed crit took Chi-Yu to 1
blocked Overheat (an OHKO); partner Giga Drain KO'd Chi-Yu
blocked Icicle Crash (an OHKO); partner Melmetal died anyway
blocked Stomping Tantrum and made Sucker Punch fail - good, but as the last Pokemon it only delayed

protect_summary: 4 Protects, all blocked a real hit.
ai_notes: Sound throughout. Two Rayquaza crits and one Icicle Crash miss made it closer than the board was; the Cradily-for-Metagross switch into an Ice move cost 75 HP but was defensible (Cradily was the Icicle Crash target).
level_change_rationale: Won first try 6-3 in 7 turns with three real KOs taken. Keep.
cooler: Exhibition feels right. Storm Drain never had a Water attack to pull and Weakness Policy never fired - the two showcase mechanics need a player who brings Water/SE moves, which a Fire/Fighting answer team does not. No set change recommended.
legality_notes: Sets legal; driver accepted the party.
